Subject: Follow-up: scheduling 30-min product demo + prep checklist

Hi Alex + Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Nice to meet both of you. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

1) Goal: 30-min intro demo (product capabilities + high-level infra model) to validate fit with your ops/security checklist.
2) Attendees we suggest: your product manager (Priya), an infra/ops SME, and our infra lead (Priyom) and security SME (Neha).
3) Prep: I attached a short agenda and a mini SSO readiness checklist — they are just to surface any obvious blockers before a technical deep dive.

Please pick one of these 30-minute windows (all PST):
- Option A: Thu Sep 21 — 9:00–9:30am
- Option B: Thu Sep 21 — 2:00–2:30pm
- Option C: Fri Sep 22 — 11:00–11:30am

If none of those work, suggest two alternatives and I’ll coordinate. Also, please tell us which internal BrightLayer people will join so we can tailor the agenda.

Attaching: BrightLayer-demo-agenda.pdf, redwood-mini-sso-checklist.docx

Link to mutual action plan (HubSpot): https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8375

Thanks — I’ll hold Option B tentatively until EOD.

Marissa

- If there are any must-have integrations (Okta domain, S3 endpoints), flag them now so we can show a config example.
